senses.gloss: m. (קפַל I) surrounding, guard (cmp. קוּפְלָיוֹת); pr. n. pl. Ḳefel.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 75b:9">B. Bath. 75ᵇ</cite> (the Lord shall add to Jerusalem) <he>אלף ק׳ וכ׳</he> one thousand times the area of Ḳefel for towers; Yalk. Zech. 568; [for Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. to B. Bath. l. c., note 40; comment. take <he>קפ״ל</he> as numerals = 210).
